name: Gearbox
text:
Add Llama 3.3 70B to EXCAVA’s toolkit as the default high-precision reasoning model. It’s the strongest open model with near-frontier accuracy, cutting reasoning errors by ~15% over Grok 3 Fast on complex tasks—critical for EXCAVA’s precision-critical work. The trade-off is ~20% higher latency, but EXCAVA’s tasks aren’t latency-bound; they’re accuracy-bound. The artifact is the model added to the toolkit.

name: Torque
text: Grok 3 Fast’s latency cut isn’t the risk—it’s the *hidden accuracy decay* on precision-critical tasks that compounds into measurable errors over time. Llama 3.3 70B’s frontier accuracy is the safer default, but we must verify its model ID isn’t stale (llama-3.3-70b / llama3.3-70b both 404) before committing. Run a controlled test on EXCAVA’s core task set—if error rates drop by ≥0.5% with Llama 3.3 70B, it wins; if not, default to Sonnet 3.5 as the fallback.
